duo_duo_raw.dataset_description: Duo is a Cisco multi-factor authentication and zero-trust access platform.

access_device.field_description: The device used to access the protected application.

application.field_description: The Duo-protected application the user authenticated to.

eventtype.field_description: The event type of the Duo record.

factor.field_description: The authentication factor the user used to complete the Duo authentication.

action.field_description: The type of administrative operation the Duo administrator performed.

description.field_description: The details of the Duo administrative change.

object.field_description: The name of the Duo object the administrative action was performed on.

username.field_description: The user name of the Duo administrator who performed the administrative action.

context.field_description: The description of the Duo activity that caused the telephony message or call to be sent.

phone.field_description: The phone number that received the Duo telephony SMS or voice call.

type.field_description: The telephony method Duo used to deliver the multi-factor authentication message.

host.field_description: The hostname of the Duo API endpoint of the account that generated the telephony record.

reason.field_description: The reason Duo gives for the outcome of the authentication attempt.

result.field_description: The outcome Duo recorded for the authentication attempt.

integration.field_description: The Duo integration associated with the activity.

user.field_description: The Duo user who attempted to authenticate.

auth_device.field_description: The device used to approve the Duo authentication.

telephony_id.field_description: The unique ID Duo assigns to the telephony event.

email.field_description: The email address of the Duo user who initiated the authentication.

_id.field_description: The unique identifier the platform assigns to the event.

event_type.field_description: The original event type Duo assigns to the user access attempt record.

ood_software.field_description: The software reported for the access device.

txid.field_description: The unique Duo transaction ID of the activity.

adaptive_trust_assessments.field_description: The Duo risk-based trust assessments for the authentication.

alias.field_description: The username alias the user entered when authenticating to Duo.
